title: Hallen strength training program
desc: This novice-friendly training program is designed to help you gain strength. Perfect for those with some experience in lifting, this program has easy-to-follow workouts that gradually increase in intensity, making sure that you see progress without feeling overwhelmed.

ex.note:
Set 1: 4-6 reps (Heaviest, RPE 9-10)
	•	Set 2: 6-8 reps (Moderate, RPE 8-9)
	•	Set 3: 8-10 reps (Lighter, RPE 7-8)
	•	Optional: AMRAP set with ~50-60% of top set weight

Set 1: 4-6 reps (Heaviest, RPE 9-10)
	•	Set 2: 6-8 reps (Moderate, RPE 8-9)
	•	Set 3: 8-10 reps (Lighter, RPE 7-8)
	•	Optional: AMRAP set with ~50-60% of top set weight

1️⃣ Deadlift (Barbell)
	•	Set 1: 4-6 reps (Heaviest, RPE 9-10)
	•	Set 2: 6-8 reps (Moderate, RPE 8-9)
	•	Set 3: 8-10 reps (Lighter, RPE 7-8)
	•	Set 4: AMRAP at ~50-60% of top set

ss.note: Slow eccentric for max tension)

Set 1: 5 reps (RPE 9-10) – Heavy
	•	Set 2: 6-8 reps (RPE 8-9) – Moderate
	•	Set 3: 8-10 reps (RPE 7-8) – Lighter, focus on depth
	•	Set 4: AMRAP (50-60% weight)
Slow tempo for maximum muscle activation

	•	Set 4: AMRAP (50-60% weight)
